en: A monochrome postcard showing a two‑storey colonial-style government building with wide verandas supported by thin columns, a tiled or metal gabled roof, and a spiral staircase on the right leading to an upper terrace. Potted plants line the ground floor veranda and a grassy yard with a low fence is in the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the top of the image in Portuguese and English, identifying the building as Agriculture Department offices at Umbeluzi.
